description: Figure 7 presents a bar chart illustrating the CoLeG-E metric, which is labeled on the vertical axis as "CoLeG-E (%)" and scaled linearly from 0 to 50, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists three model scales from the LLaMA-2 family: "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B", and "LLaMA-2-70B". For each model scale, four bars are displayed, each representing a different level of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applied to the model, as indicated by the legend: "no SFT" (light blue with diagonal hatching), "+ SFT on D₀" (orange with diagonal hatching), "+ SFT on D₀, D₁" (light purple with diagonal hatching), and "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂" (pink with diagonal hatching). The bars are grouped by model scale and are not sorted. The chart visually shows that for each model scale, the CoLeG-E score increases as more datasets (D₀, D₁, D₂) are included in the SFT process. The shortest bar is for "LLaMA-2-7B" with "no SFT", reaching approximately 4%. The tallest bar is for "LLaMA-2-70B" with "+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂", reaching approximately 50%. The bars for "LLaMA-2-7B" are the shortest overall, while those for "LLaMA-2-70B" are the tallest. The bars are not visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
